warnings: RESOLVED BY MAKHAM 2026-08-24 (was: three span_source:'unresolved' placeholders). Two interior secondary beam marks — B1 (splits rooms into north/south halves in two different locations: inside the 1-2 x B-C bathroom cluster, and again inside the 2-3 x A-B bedroom-2/laundry cluster) and B2 (splits the north half of the 1-2 x B-C room into east/west halves) — still have NO printed dimension anywhere in the structural set locating their offset from the main grid; only their existence, mark and rebar spec (S-09) are printed. The first extraction therefore left all three at span_source:'unresolved' with a descriptive grid_ref, per '§4 pos_m always read from a printed dimension line — never guessed'. On review Makham ruled all three sit at the MIDPOINT of their bay, which creates dummy lines 1''(x=2.00), A'''(y=2.00) and B'(y=6.00) in the grid master, and lets the three beams take exact grid refs and spans: B1 = B'1→B'2 (4.00m), B2 = B1''→B'1'' (2.00m), B1 = A'''2→A'''3 (4.00m). That y-line was created as A'' and renumbered to A''' the same day when A''(-1.00) was inserted above it for the north-strip beam B5. This is a HUMAN RULING, not a printed dimension — each element and each new grid line carries a 'position_ruled_by_makham_2026-08-24_not_printed' flag, and the earlier note about a faint unlabeled CAD construction line near the B2 position still stands as visual-only corroboration, not as a dimension. Independent pixel check on this PNG at 4x agrees within drafting tolerance (upper B1 A+1.88m, lower B1 B+2.21m, B2 1+1.95m), as do the equal S2/S2 and S3/S3 slab pairs either side of each beam and B1's own S-09 midspan bars (3.20m = 0.8 x 4.00m span). Note house #07's B2 interior beam — cited by the first extraction as the precedent for leaving this unresolved — may now be worth revisiting under the same ruling.

The mark 'B5' is used twice at genuinely different locations: the north strip beam (A''2-A''3, 4.00m — on dummy row A''(-1.00), NOT on row A; corrected 2026-08-24) and the south ramp/deck edge beam (C'1-C'3, 8.00m). This is printed twice on the sheet, not a transcription duplicate.

The small bay east of grid 3 (the 'ซักล้าง'/laundry room, per A-04 architecture, viewed only for context) is framed with its own tie beams (B3X, B5A, B5B) running close to and parallel with the main grid-3 line (B4X). Their exact offset east of grid 3 is not independently dimensioned on this sheet beyond the shared 1.50m module used everywhere else on the drawing (matching dummy grid 3' from the roof-level ring beam) — recorded here using grid 3' by analogy by re-using the module, at reduced confidence, rather than inventing an unrelated number. Whether the bay's inner (B3X) and outer (B5A/B5B) beams occupy genuinely different x-positions or are a double-line drafting convention for one wall could not be resolved with confidence from the plan view alone.

'BX' (ramp/entry threshold beam, per its own tapered/level-step cross-section on S-10) appears at both the west ramp zone (near B6/B6X) and a symmetric position on the east side of row C. Its exact plan position within each 1.50m taper zone is not clearly dimensioned separately from B6X's own run — recorded with span_source:'unresolved' at both occurrences rather than forcing a precise but unconfirmed grid_ref_start/end.
'SI'/'S1' and similar slab-marker confusion was checked per §10 — this sheet's markers read clearly as S0/S1/S2/S3 (digits), no ambiguity found.

Slab markers S3 (the smallest, most numerous zone type — ramp support strip, small bathroom/utility rooms, the small east bay, and the north offset strip) are merged into one element_id per §0.1/§4 with approximate per-room grid_refs, since each is a room-area marker, not a true single point.

SLAB COUNTS CORRECTED BY MAKHAM 2026-08-24. Ruling: S1=2, S2=2, S3=11, S0=3. S1 and S2 already read 2 and 2 and were left alone; S3 went 8 → 11 and S0 went 2 → 3. The misses were all at the edge of the framed square rather than inside it — the 1.10m offset strip north of row A (bay 2-3), the north-east corner bay, the north part of the west strip in B-C, and the C-C' deck strip in bay 2-3 — i.e. the first extraction counted the rooms it had already framed and under-swept the perimeter. Re-counted circle-by-circle on หน้า26 at 2.4x in two overlapping crops after the ruling: 2 / 2 / 11 / 3, matching Makham exactly.

CLOSED BY MAKHAM 2026-08-24 (was logged here as an open finding from the slab re-count). The beam recorded as 'B5, A2-A3, 4.00m' did not sit on row A: mark B5 labels a beam about 1.00m NORTH of row A running grid 2 to grid 3, with a B3X dropping from each end down to the row-A columns and slab S3 in the strip between — a real framed bay, not a roof overhang. Everything in that finding is now applied: dummy row A''(-1.00) added to the grid master; B5 moved to A''2-A''3; the row-A beam B4 (which was missing from elements[] altogether) added at A2-A3; both B3X drops added at 1.00m; and B5A's two runs re-anchored to A'' as well. Makham's ruling on pos_m: -1.00, the beam CENTRELINE (scan reads -1.01), not the printed 1.10 — that number lands on the beam's north face where the roofline coincides with it, and it carries on west through bay 1-2 where a scan at x=1250 finds the roofline alone with no beam, so it stays a roofline dimension. Inserting A'' forced the prime renumber that was anticipated: the interior-B1 row created earlier the same day as A''(+2.00) is now A'''(+2.00), and this file's B1 and S2 entries were rewritten to match.

OPEN — FOUND 2026-08-24 WHILE FIXING THE NORTH STRIP, NOT APPLIED, NEEDS MAKHAM'S CALL. Mark 'B4X' may be recorded with the wrong orientation. This file has it as two VERTICAL runs (A3-B3 and B3-C3, i.e. on grid 3). But on หน้า26 the two printed 'B4X' labels are HORIZONTAL text sitting just below the row-A line and just below the row-B line, both east of grid 3 — the position a label takes for an east-west beam in the small east bay, which would make them A3-A3' and B3-B3' instead. The same reading also affects 'B3' and 'B3X', whose vertical labels sit just east of grid 3 at two different heights, and which may be the runs actually on grid 3. This was noticed from label placement on a 2x crop, which is weaker evidence than the pixel scans used for the north strip, so nothing was changed. Settling it needs one focused pass over the whole east bay (grid 3 to 3', rows A'' to C) rather than element-by-element guesses.
